name: Canyon
verdict: Canyon is controlled by Groupe Bruxelles Lambert, a Brussels-listed investment holding (52.6% of the share capital). Nothing found.
note: German premium bike brand; title sponsor of Canyon//SRAM and bike partner of Alpecin-Premier Tech. Rating note: majority owner GBL is a listed Belgian holding; founder Roman Arnold remains a significant shareholder (claim canyon-gbl-ownership); no state capital found.
